verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a docs title, "Send events directly to mParticle". It suggests a first-party way to send events straight to mParticle, but nothing in the pack describes an HTTP server-to-server endpoint, its authentication scheme, or any delivery or retry guarantees. The /developers/apis/http/ page in the pack covers Warehouse Sync, which is warehouse ingestion rather than event ingestion, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented server-to-server HTTP event endpoint details, authentication mechanism, delivery guarantees/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees
